## Summary

Describe the smallest complete change and why it is needed.

## Contract

- [ ] I identified the protocol, domain, or repository contract that owns this behavior.
- [ ] This change does not silently redefine canonical 0x1 semantics.

## Verification

Describe tests, builds, contract checks, or manual verification performed.

## Licensing and contribution rights

- [ ] New authored source/config files carry the canonical copyright header and `SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0` where the format supports comments.
- [ ] Third-party material and required notices are identified and preserved.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution and have read `CLA.md`; I understand maintainers may require explicit CLA acceptance before an external contribution is merged.

## Compatibility / security

- [ ] I documented any compatibility, migration, security, or licensing impact, or none applies.
